article.story: NORTH ANDOVER, Mass. -- — Kevair Kennedy's 22 points helped Merrimack defeat Marist 81-56 on Thursday. Kennedy added seven assists and four steals for the Warriors (17-9, 13-2 Metro Atlantic Athletic Conference). Tye Dorset shot 5 for 8 (2 for 5 from 3-point range) and 3 of 7 from the free-throw line to add 15 points. Andres Marrero had 13 points and went 5 of 8 from the field (3 for 6 from 3-point range). Jason Schofield finished with 13 points and 11 rebounds for the Red Foxes (16-9, 10-6). Marist also got 11 points from Rhyjon Blackwell. Jaden Daughtry also had 10 points and 10 rebounds. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
